title: Part Three, Chapter 2: The First Men

verses.t: These were the names of the first men who were formed: the first man was called Balam-quitzé, the second Balam-acab, the third Mahucutah and the fourth Yquibalam. And these are the names of our first fathers and mothers. They are called only the formed ones and the created ones; they had no fathers or mothers; we call them simply men. They were not born of women, nor were they begotten by the Creator; but they were formed and created by a miracle, by the Creator, who was called Tepeu and Cucumatz. And when they had been made men, in their image, they were men who spoke and talked, who saw and heard, who walked and could touch things; they were good and handsome men, and their likeness was that of men, and they had breath. And when they looked, their sight reached to see everything, and they knew all there is in the world; and when they looked, they would look again and turn their gaze over everything that is in the sky and on the earth, and there was nothing that could block their view of all there is. And our first fathers did not need to walk or run to see all that is in the sky; they stayed in one place and saw everything. Great was their wisdom, and their likeness surpassed the trees, the stones, the lake, the sea, the mountain and the plain; and Balam-quitzé, Balam-acab, Mahucutah and Yquibalam were very precious men. And then they were asked by the Creator, "How is your state? Do you hear? Do you see? Are your walking and your speech good? Look and see the whole world. Do you see the mountains and the plains clearly? Try to see everything!" it was said to them. And at once they saw all that there was in the world, and then they gave thanks to the Creator and Former, saying, "Truly we thank you many times, because you have created us men; you have given us mouth and face, and that we might speak and hear; we move and walk and we have feeling, and we know all that is far and near, and we also see the great and the small, the sky and the earth. And so we thank you that you created us, and we were created and formed. You are our grandmother and our grandfather," they said, giving thanks for their creation. And they came to know everything, and to see as far as the four corners of the sky and of the earth, and what was within the sky and within the earth. And this did not seem good to the Formers and Creators: "This is not good, what our creatures have said, that they say and know all there is, small and great."

And so the Creators held council again: "What shall we do with these now, so that they see only what is near, so that their eyes see only a little of the face of the earth? For what they say is not good. Are they not merely creatures? Are they to be gods as well? And what if they do not multiply when the time of the dawn comes, what if they do not increase? Let us undo them a little, for there is still something lacking to be done. What we see is not good. Are we to be made equal, all who know everything there is and see everything?" This was said by the Heart of the Sky, Huracán, Chipi-caculha, Raxa-caculha, Tepeu and Cucumatz the Creator, and to the old man Xpiyacoc and to Xmucane, who are called Creators. And afterwards they disposed their creatures differently.

And then a mist was breathed onto their eyes by the one who was the Heart of the Sky, and he clouded them, as when one breathes on a mirror and clouds it; so he clouded their eyes, and so they could see only what was near; only that was clear to them. And so the wisdom and understanding of the four first men was lost; and so our first fathers were formed by the Heart of the Sky and of the Earth.
